scenes.text: Kya tum bhi har mahine Google ko sirf photos rakhne ke liye paise de rahe ho? Phone ki storage full ho jaati hai, aur phir Google bolta hai ki plan upgrade karo.
Iska ek free tareeka hai. Immich naam ka ek tool hai,
jo tumhari saari photos tumhare apne laptop ya hard disk pe backup kar deta hai.
Aur search bhi karta hai. Beach likhoge, toh saari beach waali photos saamne aa jaayengi.
Agar iska link chahiye, toh comment mein PHOTOS likh do, main tumhe DM kar dunga.
